scope: Existing local Release executable. Offline discovery and help only. No Gateway calls or operation invocations.

mcp-help.stdout:
Description:
  Serve the generic MCP tools over stdio. Explicit --format table and --output are rejected.

Usage:
  hexalith mcp [options]

Options:
  --transport <transport>  stdio (default). HTTP transport is planned for the next release.
  -?, -h, --help           Show help and usage information
  --url <url>              Gateway URL (EVENTSTORE_URL). With a token, use the same source for both.
  --token <token>          Gateway Bearer [REDACTED] (EVENTSTORE_TOKEN)
  --tenant <tenant>        Session tenant (EVENTSTORE_TENANT)
  --actor <actor>          Trusted operator actor (EVENTSTORE_ACTOR)
  --allow-tenant-override  Allow MCP per-call tenant overrides (EVENTSTORE_ALLOW_TENANT_OVERRIDE). Defaults to true when supplied. Use --allow-tenant-override false to disable.
  --profile <profile>      Connection profile (EVENTSTORE_PROFILE). Profile management uses its own arguments.
  --format <format>        Result format, json or table (EVENTSTORE_FORMAT)
  --output <output>        Write the result to a file (flag only)
  --read-only              Disable command submission (EVENTSTORE_READ_ONLY). Defaults to true when supplied. Use --read-only false to disable.
  --strict                 Reject any Catalog diagnostic (EVENTSTORE_STRICT). Defaults to true when supplied. Use --strict false to disable.

config-help.stdout:
Description:
  Inspect and manage mcpcli profile settings

Usage:
  hexalith config [command] [options]

Options:
  -?, -h, --help           Show help and usage information
  --url <url>              Gateway URL (EVENTSTORE_URL). With a token, use the same source for both.
  --token <token>          Gateway Bearer [REDACTED] (EVENTSTORE_TOKEN)
  --tenant <tenant>        Session tenant (EVENTSTORE_TENANT)
  --actor <actor>          Trusted operator actor (EVENTSTORE_ACTOR)
  --allow-tenant-override  Allow MCP per-call tenant overrides (EVENTSTORE_ALLOW_TENANT_OVERRIDE). Defaults to true when supplied. Use --allow-tenant-override false to disable.
  --profile <profile>      Connection profile (EVENTSTORE_PROFILE). Profile management uses its own arguments.
  --format <format>        Result format, json or table (EVENTSTORE_FORMAT)
  --output <output>        Write the result to a file (flag only)
  --read-only              Disable command submission (EVENTSTORE_READ_ONLY). Defaults to true when supplied. Use --read-only false to disable.
  --strict                 Reject any Catalog diagnostic (EVENTSTORE_STRICT). Defaults to true when supplied. Use --strict false to disable.

Commands:
  current                        Show resolved settings and sources
  profile                        Manage named connection profiles
  use <name>                     Select or clear the active profile
  set <profile> <field> <value>  Set tenant, actor, allowTenantOverride, or allowedExtensions
